_meta.description: RADAR per-service logs lifecycle policy. Fluent Bit writes a NEW index per service per day (radar-<service>-logs-YYYY.MM.DD via Logstash_Format), so the daily index is itself the roll — there is no rollover alias to act on, and this policy's job is the other half ILM controls: retention. The delete phase removes a daily index 7 days after it was created, so splitting logs ~8-fold per service cannot grow shard/disk use without bound. The hot phase only sets priority so recovery favours recent logs.
